title: AGL Energy Limited - proposed acquisition of Great Energy Alliance Corporation Pty Limited
targets: Great Energy Alliance Corporation Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC requested further information from the merger parties. Former proposed decision date of 19 April 2012 delayed. ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt of the information.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 17 May 2012, amended to allow merger parties to provide further information.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.
